agents_section2_exact:
## 2. Safety constraints that must never be violated

1. The external power switch is the pad arming device: the board is switched on only with the vehicle on the pad / rail, and the pyro channel is live whenever the board is on. Firmware never fires before it has detected launch (accelerometer + barometer), and on the ground continuity / bus readings are hard refusals (§2.3).
2. The power switch is turned on last and off first; the pyro bus is taken after the load switch (RAW), never straight from the battery.
3. In flight, continuity / ARM_SENSE readings are only logged and annunciated and **never veto a fire**; on the ground they are hard refusals (`docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md` F-10).
4. Pyro FET gates must have a pull-down, a series resistor and a gate-source capacitor, and must be defined off while the MCU is in reset or unpowered.
5. An inference that has not been measured or checked against the original datasheet must be labelled as an inference, never written as fact.

PA11.reason: DFU is the loader interface itself (R8 allowance); members not pinned (USB contract)

PA12.reason: DFU is the loader interface itself (R8 allowance); members not pinned (USB contract)

PA2.reason: USART2_TX drives the servo-3 signal through R152 1k: R8's allowance (frozen 3.2; a servo never sends 0x7F); servo power is off the board (O3), so a byte at most twitches an unpowered or harness-powered servo on the bench (BOOT0 is a bench-only state)

PA3.reason: USART2_RX: an input (AN2606 p. 278 lists both no pull and pull-up), never driven; the line is held by R157 10k and driven only by U1 itself in flight

PA4.reason: SPI1_NSS: a slave input, no pull (p. 279), never driven; U11 ST with its R91 10k pull-up (R8 pin table) is the only driver

PA5.reason: SPI1_SCK: a slave input, no pull (p. 279), never driven; U9 FLT with its R89 10k pull-up (R8 pin table) is the only driver

PA6.reason: SPI1_MISO is driven push-pull by the loader into the VLOGIC divider node (R60 100k from VLOGIC, R61 10k to GND, C60 10 nF): the pin current is at most 3.3 V / (10k || 100k) = 0.36 mA (VLOGIC at 0 V, pin high), far below the 20 mA absolute-maximum I/O current (DS12110 Rev 10 Table 22, p. 105); VLOGIC (<= 8.4 V) reaches the pin only through R60 (<= 84 uA into a low pin); the reading is wrong only while in the loader

PB6.reason: I2C1_SCL open drain, no pull: R8's allowance (frozen 3.5): the R10 10k pull-up keeps the flash deselected; the loader as an I2C slave pulls SCL low only to stretch a clock it receives

PB9.reason: I2C1_SDA open drain, no pull: R8's allowance (frozen 3.6): the barometer's own I2C data line with its 4.7k pull-up; the loader answers only address 0b1001110x, which the barometer (0x76 / 0x77) does not use

PC10.reason: SPI3_SCK is a loader slave input, never driven; J430.5 is the card clock input. PD0 SD_CS has R460 10k to 3V3, keeping the card deselected while all GPIOs are reset inputs

PC11.reason: SPI3_MISO is driven by the loader only during a host transfer; PD0 SD_CS is independent of the loader SPI3_NSS PA15 and is held high by R460 10k, so the card data output stays high impedance. R462 draws at most 3.3V/10k=0.33mA if PC11 drives low; bench BOOT0 use only

PC12.reason: SPI3_MOSI is a loader slave input, never driven; J430.3 is the card command input and R461 10k holds it high while the card stays deselected by SD_CS

PE11.reason: SPI4_NSS: a slave input, no pull (AN2606 p. 280): R431 100k holds U402 EN low, so the camera supply stays off in the loader

PE12.reason: SPI4_SCK: a slave input, no pull (p. 280), never driven; U402 FAULT is open drain (TPS2553 data sheet) with the R432 10k pull-up
